# Best 3-in-1 Qi2 charging stands for iPhone, Apple Watch and AirPods

**My pick for most people: Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand.** WIRED named it best overall after testing 30+ models. It charges the iPhone at up to 15W and fast-charges an Apple Watch Series 7 or newer. The AirPods sit on the base, and the phone pad tilts and works in landscape for StandBy mode. A 36W power supply is included. List price is $109, with WIRED listing about $98 and Amazon around $90, and Best Buy around $80. [Buy links in WIRED's guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

## Other good options

| Need | Pick | Price (per the reviews) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Fastest | Nomad Stand One Max | $169 | 25W Qi2 for the iPhone and a heavy, stable base. No power adapter is included; you need a 40W one (Nomad's is $25). |
| Cheapest | ESR Qi2 3-in-1 Charging Station | $80, listed at $40 on Amazon | 15W, adapter and cable included. The Watch charger is a detachable unit, and WIRED lost the cap. |
| Sleeping with the screens out of sight | Nimble Podium 3-in-1 | $130 | Lies flat or pops up, supports Qi2 25W, and charges the Watch slowly. |
| Desk use that also folds for travel | Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable (Qi2 25W) | $129.99 | Macworld calls it the tallest and most adjustable foldable stand. It includes a 45W adapter and UK/EU plugs. [Macworld review](https://www.macworld.com/article/3114208/satechi-3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-review.html) |
| Compact travel | Anker MagGo 3-in-1 (Qi2) | $110, listed at $80 | 15W, 2-year warranty. It can feel crowded when fully loaded. |
| Fast travel charger with a cooling fan | ESR CryoBoost 3-in-1 (Qi2.2 25W) | $99.99 | Includes a 50W adapter and a button to turn the fan off. WIRED found the plastic build less premium. |

Links for the travel picks are in [WIRED's travel charger guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/).

## Things to know

- **25W matters less than it sounds.** WIRED says the faster Qi2 25W standard makes little difference if you charge overnight. Only some iPhones get the full speed. ESR says 25W applies to the iPhone 17 series, 16 Pro Max and 16 Plus. The iPhone 16 and 16 Pro get 20W, and older models get 15W.
- **Your AirPods case must support wireless charging.** The original AirPods case doesn't.
- **Dealectric lists the ESR CryoBoost at $99.99 and claims code PARTNER18 takes it to about $82** through ESR's US store. That page is an affiliate link, so Dealectric earns a commission. I haven't verified the code myself, and ESR's checkout has the final word. [ESR CryoBoost at Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand)
- Prices change often, so check the current price before buying.

For a typical nightstand setup, I'd get the Belkin. If you have a recent iPhone and want the fastest option, the Nomad is the one to pick. If you want to spend as little as possible, the ESR at around $40 is the best value.
